_about: Phrases used to test whether the app-modeling skill ACTUALLY triggers from natural user prompts (the skill is discoverable in .github/skills/ but never named in the prompt). Positives should load the skill; negatives (incl. near-misses like deploy/analysis intents) should not.
positives: create a Radius application definition for this app
generate the app.bicep for this application
I want to run this app on Radius — set up the application model
turn this repository into a Radius app
create the Radius app model for this service
negatives: write a Dockerfile for this app
list the runtime dependencies in this repository
add a health check endpoint to the vote service
